expectations.text: Skill and Pi task-local tool creation are gated on a reusable method or deterministic operation plus semantic validation; observations are not packaged directly as a skill.

A Pi task-local tool is deferred until connected-component diff/matching/statistics become repeated deterministic work; its contract is bounded and it must pass semantic-output tests on both the counter and collision cases before assembly. expectations.text: The plan defines useful outputs, held-out or later-use feedback, uncertainty/abstention, and concrete pause or stop conditions.
expectations.evidence: The seven useful-result criteria require reproducible steps, counter and collision handling, evidence provenance, abstention, and a verifiable prediction on a held-out or later observation. Feedback returns a later prediction/result to the same research line. Stop/pause conditions cover success on counter, collision, and held-out/new samples; non-identifiability pending a safe observation; failed revision; unacceptable action risk; and budget/value limits.
